source: W3C WCAG 2.0 (2008), 2.1 (2018, updated 2023) and 2.2 (2023, updated 2024) Recommendations. automatable, probes, failure_patterns and manual_check are this skill's own rubric, not W3C text.

success_criteria.title: Non-text Content

failure_patterns.description: Informative image, icon or image button with no text alternative
Linked or button image with no accessible name (the control is unnamed)
Text alternative present but does not convey the purpose (filename, "image")
Decorative image exposed with redundant or noisy text

success_criteria.manual_check: For each image, icon, chart and CAPTCHA, check the text alternative conveys the same purpose; decorative images are hidden from assistive technology.

success_criteria.title: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)

failure_patterns.description: Prerecorded audio-only or video-only content with no alternative

success_criteria.manual_check: For each prerecorded audio-only or video-only item, check a transcript or equivalent alternative is provided.

success_criteria.title: Captions (Prerecorded)

failure_patterns.description: Prerecorded video with speech and no captions

success_criteria.manual_check: Play each prerecorded video with audio; check synchronised captions exist and cover speech and important sounds.

success_criteria.title: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)

failure_patterns.description: Video with important visual information and no description or text alternative

success_criteria.manual_check: For each prerecorded video, check audio description or a full text alternative covers visual information.

success_criteria.title: Captions (Live)

failure_patterns.description: Live audio without captions

success_criteria.manual_check: For live audio in synchronised media, check live captions are provided.

success_criteria.title: Audio Description (Prerecorded)

failure_patterns.description: Prerecorded video with no audio description

success_criteria.manual_check: For each prerecorded video, check audio description covers visual information not in the soundtrack.

success_criteria.title: Sign Language (Prerecorded)

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 1.2.6 Sign Language (Prerecorded)

success_criteria.manual_check: Check sign language interpretation is provided for prerecorded audio.

success_criteria.title: Extended Audio Description (Prerecorded)

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 1.2.7 Extended Audio Description (Prerecorded)

success_criteria.manual_check: Check extended audio description where pauses are too short.

success_criteria.title: Media Alternative (Prerecorded)

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 1.2.8 Media Alternative (Prerecorded)

success_criteria.manual_check: Check a full text alternative for every prerecorded synchronised and video-only item.

success_criteria.title: Audio-only (Live)

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 1.2.9 Audio-only (Live)

success_criteria.manual_check: Check an alternative for live audio-only content.

success_criteria.title: Info and Relationships

failure_patterns.description: Visual headings, lists or tables not marked up as such
Related controls (radio groups, required markers) not programmatically associated
Data table without header associations
ARIA roles with missing required children or parents

success_criteria.manual_check: Compare the visual structure (headings, lists, tables, form groups, required fields) with the accessibility tree.

success_criteria.title: Meaningful Sequence

failure_patterns.description: DOM order changes meaning compared with the visual order

success_criteria.manual_check: Read the page in DOM order (screen reader or CSS off); check the meaning is preserved.

success_criteria.title: Sensory Characteristics

failure_patterns.description: Instructions that rely only on shape, position or colour

success_criteria.manual_check: Check instructions do not rely only on shape, colour, size, location, orientation or sound.

success_criteria.title: Orientation

failure_patterns.description: Content restricted to one orientation without need

success_criteria.manual_check: Rotate a mobile viewport between portrait and landscape; check content is not locked to one.

success_criteria.title: Identify Input Purpose

failure_patterns.description: Personal-data field without a valid autocomplete token

success_criteria.manual_check: Check fields collecting information about the user have the matching autocomplete token.

success_criteria.title: Identify Purpose

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 1.3.6 Identify Purpose

success_criteria.manual_check: Check the purpose of components, icons and regions is programmatically determinable.

success_criteria.title: Use of Color

failure_patterns.description: Link in text distinguished by colour alone
Errors, required fields or states shown by colour alone

success_criteria.manual_check: Check colour is not the only way information is conveyed (links in text, errors, charts, required fields).

success_criteria.title: Audio Control

failure_patterns.description: Audio autoplays for more than 3 seconds with no pause, stop or volume control

success_criteria.manual_check: Check audio that plays automatically for more than 3 seconds can be paused, stopped or muted independently.

success_criteria.title: Contrast (Minimum)

failure_patterns.description: Body or control text below 4.5:1 (3:1 large)
Secondary text (captions, footers, placeholders) below the threshold

success_criteria.manual_check: Check text the engines could not compute (over images, gradients, pseudo-elements, states) reaches 4.5:1 (3:1 large).

success_criteria.title: Resize Text

failure_patterns.description: Text clipped, truncated or overlapping at 200% zoom
Viewport meta prevents zoom (user-scalable=no or maximum-scale<2)

success_criteria.manual_check: Zoom to 200%; check no text is clipped, truncated or overlapping and nothing is lost.

success_criteria.title: Images of Text

failure_patterns.description: Text presented as an image

success_criteria.manual_check: Check text is not presented as an image unless customisable or essential (logos).

success_criteria.title: Contrast (Enhanced)

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 1.4.6 Contrast (Enhanced)

success_criteria.manual_check: Check text reaches 7:1 (4.5:1 large).

success_criteria.title: Low or No Background Audio

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 1.4.7 Low or No Background Audio

success_criteria.manual_check: Check background audio in speech recordings.

success_criteria.title: Visual Presentation

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 1.4.8 Visual Presentation

success_criteria.manual_check: Check user selection of colours, line width, justification, spacing and 200% resizing without horizontal scrolling.

success_criteria.title: Images of Text (No Exception)

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 1.4.9 Images of Text (No Exception)

success_criteria.manual_check: Check images of text are pure decoration or essential.

success_criteria.title: Reflow

failure_patterns.description: Two-dimensional scrolling at 320 CSS px for content that is not exempt
Content or function cut off or hidden at 320 CSS px

success_criteria.manual_check: At 320 CSS px wide, check there is no two-dimensional scrolling and no content or function is lost.

success_criteria.title: Non-text Contrast

failure_patterns.description: Control boundary or state indicator below 3:1
Meaningful graphic below 3:1

success_criteria.manual_check: Check component boundaries, states, focus indicators and meaningful graphics reach 3:1 against adjacent colours.

success_criteria.title: Text Spacing

failure_patterns.description: Text clipped or overlapping with WCAG text-spacing overrides

success_criteria.manual_check: Apply the text-spacing bookmarklet; check no text is clipped or overlaps.

success_criteria.title: Content on Hover or Focus

failure_patterns.description: Content on hover or focus cannot be dismissed without moving pointer or focus
Content disappears when the pointer moves onto it
Content disappears on a timer

success_criteria.manual_check: For each tooltip, popover or submenu shown on hover or focus: check it can be dismissed with Esc, can be hovered, and persists until dismissed.

success_criteria.title: Keyboard

failure_patterns.description: Interactive control not reachable or operable by keyboard
Custom widget reachable but missing expected keys

success_criteria.manual_check: Operate every function with the keyboard alone, including custom widgets, drag-and-drop and menus.

success_criteria.title: No Keyboard Trap

failure_patterns.description: Focus cannot leave a component with standard keys

success_criteria.manual_check: Tab into and out of every component, including embedded media and dialogs; check focus is never stuck.

success_criteria.title: Keyboard (No Exception)

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception)

success_criteria.manual_check: Operate every function with the keyboard, with no path-dependent exception.

success_criteria.title: Character Key Shortcuts

failure_patterns.description: Single-character shortcut that cannot be turned off or remapped

success_criteria.manual_check: Check single-character shortcuts can be turned off, remapped, or only work on focus.

success_criteria.title: Timing Adjustable

failure_patterns.description: Time limit with no way to turn off, adjust or extend
Page refreshes or redirects on a timer

success_criteria.manual_check: Check every time limit (session timeout, auto-refresh, carousel advance) can be turned off, adjusted or extended.

success_criteria.title: Pause, Stop, Hide

failure_patterns.description: Auto-moving, blinking or scrolling content over 5 seconds with no pause

success_criteria.manual_check: Check moving, blinking, scrolling or auto-updating content lasting over 5 seconds can be paused, stopped or hidden.

success_criteria.title: No Timing

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 2.2.3 No Timing

success_criteria.manual_check: Check timing is not essential.

success_criteria.title: Interruptions

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 2.2.4 Interruptions

success_criteria.manual_check: Check interruptions can be postponed or suppressed.

success_criteria.title: Re-authenticating

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 2.2.5 Re-authenticating

success_criteria.manual_check: Check data is preserved when a session expires.

success_criteria.title: Timeouts

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 2.2.6 Timeouts

success_criteria.manual_check: Check users are warned of inactivity timeouts that lose data.

success_criteria.title: Three Flashes or Below Threshold

failure_patterns.description: Content flashes more than three times per second above threshold

success_criteria.manual_check: Check nothing flashes more than three times in one second (use PEAT or a frame analysis for video).

success_criteria.title: Three Flashes

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 2.3.2 Three Flashes

success_criteria.manual_check: Check nothing flashes more than three times in one second.

success_criteria.title: Animation from Interactions

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions

success_criteria.manual_check: Check motion triggered by interaction can be disabled (prefers-reduced-motion or a control).

success_criteria.title: Bypass Blocks

failure_patterns.description: No skip link, landmarks or headings to bypass repeated blocks

success_criteria.manual_check: Check a skip link, landmarks or headings let users bypass repeated blocks.

success_criteria.title: Page Titled

failure_patterns.description: Page has no title
Title present but does not describe the page

success_criteria.manual_check: Check each page title describes its topic or purpose and differs between pages.

success_criteria.title: Focus Order

failure_patterns.description: Focus order does not follow meaning (jumps, dialogs not receiving focus)

success_criteria.manual_check: Tab through the page; check focus order preserves meaning and operability, including dialogs that open.

success_criteria.title: Link Purpose (In Context)

failure_patterns.description: Link with no accessible name
Ambiguous link text with no context ("click here")

success_criteria.manual_check: Check each link purpose is clear from its text or programmatic context.

success_criteria.title: Multiple Ways

failure_patterns.description: Only one way to reach pages in a set

success_criteria.manual_check: Check there is more than one way to find each page (navigation, search, sitemap).

success_criteria.title: Headings and Labels

failure_patterns.description: Heading or label does not describe its purpose

success_criteria.manual_check: Check headings and labels describe their topic or purpose.

success_criteria.title: Focus Visible

failure_patterns.description: No visible focus indicator on interactive elements

success_criteria.manual_check: Tab through the page; check every focused element has a visible indicator.

success_criteria.title: Location

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 2.4.8 Location

success_criteria.manual_check: Check users can tell where they are within a set of pages.

success_criteria.title: Link Purpose (Link Only)

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 2.4.9 Link Purpose (Link Only)

success_criteria.manual_check: Check each link purpose is clear from its text alone.

success_criteria.title: Section Headings

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 2.4.10 Section Headings

success_criteria.manual_check: Check content is organised with section headings.

success_criteria.title: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)

failure_patterns.description: Focused element entirely hidden by sticky or overlay content

success_criteria.manual_check: Tab through the page with sticky headers, banners and chat widgets visible; check no focused element is entirely hidden.

success_criteria.title: Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced)

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 2.4.12 Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced)

success_criteria.manual_check: Check no part of the focused element is hidden by author content.

success_criteria.title: Focus Appearance

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 2.4.13 Focus Appearance

success_criteria.manual_check: Check the focus indicator area and 3:1 change of contrast.

success_criteria.title: Pointer Gestures

failure_patterns.description: Multipoint or path gesture with no single-pointer alternative

success_criteria.manual_check: Check multipoint or path-based gestures (pinch, swipe) have a single-pointer alternative.

success_criteria.title: Pointer Cancellation

failure_patterns.description: Action fires on the down-event with no abort or undo

success_criteria.manual_check: Check single-pointer actions fire on the up-event or can be aborted or undone.

success_criteria.title: Label in Name

failure_patterns.description: Accessible name does not contain the visible label

success_criteria.manual_check: Check the accessible name of each control contains its visible label text.

success_criteria.title: Motion Actuation

failure_patterns.description: Function operated only by device motion

success_criteria.manual_check: Check functions triggered by device motion have a UI alternative and can be disabled.

success_criteria.title: Target Size (Enhanced)

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced)

success_criteria.manual_check: Check targets are at least 44 by 44 CSS px.

success_criteria.title: Concurrent Input Mechanisms

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 2.5.6 Concurrent Input Mechanisms

success_criteria.manual_check: Check content does not restrict input modalities.

success_criteria.title: Dragging Movements

failure_patterns.description: Dragging with no single-pointer alternative

success_criteria.manual_check: Check every drag operation (sliders, sortable lists, maps) has a single-pointer alternative.

success_criteria.title: Target Size (Minimum)

failure_patterns.description: Target under 24 by 24 CSS px without sufficient spacing or an exception

success_criteria.manual_check: Check targets the probe flagged against the spacing, equivalent, inline, user-agent and essential exceptions.

success_criteria.title: Language of Page

failure_patterns.description: Page language missing or invalid
Page language set to a different language from the content

success_criteria.manual_check: Check the lang attribute matches the main language of the page.

success_criteria.title: Language of Parts

failure_patterns.description: Passage in another language not marked

success_criteria.manual_check: Check passages in another language are marked with lang.

success_criteria.title: Unusual Words

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 3.1.3 Unusual Words

success_criteria.manual_check: Check definitions for idioms and jargon.

success_criteria.title: Abbreviations

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 3.1.4 Abbreviations

success_criteria.manual_check: Check expansions for abbreviations.

success_criteria.title: Reading Level

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 3.1.5 Reading Level

success_criteria.manual_check: Check supplemental content for text above lower secondary reading level.

success_criteria.title: Pronunciation

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 3.1.6 Pronunciation

success_criteria.manual_check: Check pronunciation is available where meaning depends on it.

success_criteria.title: On Focus

failure_patterns.description: Focus alone triggers a change of context

success_criteria.manual_check: Tab through the page; check focus alone never submits a form, opens a window or moves focus unexpectedly.

success_criteria.title: On Input

failure_patterns.description: Changing a setting triggers an unannounced change of context

success_criteria.manual_check: Change each select, checkbox and field; check no unexpected change of context happens without warning.

success_criteria.title: Consistent Navigation

failure_patterns.description: Repeated navigation changes relative order between pages

success_criteria.manual_check: Compare repeated navigation across sampled pages; check the relative order is the same.

success_criteria.title: Consistent Identification

failure_patterns.description: Same function labelled differently across pages

success_criteria.manual_check: Check components with the same function are identified consistently across pages.

success_criteria.title: Change on Request

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 3.2.5 Change on Request

success_criteria.manual_check: Check changes of context happen only on user request.

success_criteria.title: Consistent Help

failure_patterns.description: Help mechanism in a different relative order between pages

success_criteria.manual_check: Check help mechanisms (contact details, chat, FAQ link) appear in the same relative order on every page that has them.

success_criteria.title: Error Identification

failure_patterns.description: Input error not identified in text, or the field not indicated

success_criteria.manual_check: Submit each form with errors (in a safe environment); check each error is identified in text and the field is indicated.

success_criteria.title: Labels or Instructions

failure_patterns.description: Input with no label or instructions
Required format or required status not stated

success_criteria.manual_check: Check every input has a visible label or instructions, including formats and required fields.

success_criteria.title: Error Suggestion

failure_patterns.description: Known correction not suggested

success_criteria.manual_check: Check error messages suggest a correction when one is known.

success_criteria.title: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)

failure_patterns.description: Legal, financial or data submission not reversible, checked or confirmed

success_criteria.manual_check: For legal, financial or data-changing submissions, check they are reversible, checked or confirmed.

success_criteria.title: Help

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 3.3.5 Help

success_criteria.manual_check: Check context-sensitive help is available.

success_criteria.title: Error Prevention (All)

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 3.3.6 Error Prevention (All)

success_criteria.manual_check: Check all submissions are reversible, checked or confirmed.

success_criteria.title: Redundant Entry

failure_patterns.description: Previously entered information must be re-entered in the same process

success_criteria.manual_check: Walk each multi-step process; check information already entered is auto-populated or selectable.

success_criteria.title: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)

failure_patterns.description: Authentication requires a cognitive function test with no alternative (paste blocked, puzzle CAPTCHA)

success_criteria.manual_check: Check sign-in does not require a cognitive function test unless an alternative, a mechanism (paste, password manager) or object recognition is allowed.

success_criteria.title: Accessible Authentication (Enhanced)

failure_patterns.description: Failure of 3.3.9 Accessible Authentication (Enhanced)

success_criteria.manual_check: Check sign-in needs no cognitive function test at all, including object recognition.

success_criteria.title: Parsing

failure_patterns.description: Duplicate IDs or malformed markup that break accessible names or relationships

success_criteria.manual_check: Obsolete in WCAG 2.2 and treated as inapplicable there; for 2.0/2.1 audits check duplicate IDs and malformed markup that affect assistive technology.

success_criteria.title: Name, Role, Value

failure_patterns.description: Control with no accessible name
Custom control without a role or state (div button, custom checkbox)
Expanded, selected or checked state not exposed or not updated

success_criteria.manual_check: For each custom control, check name, role, states and value are exposed and updated (screen reader or accessibility tree).

success_criteria.title: Status Messages

failure_patterns.description: Status message not exposed through a live region or role

success_criteria.manual_check: Trigger status messages (search results count, cart updates, form saved); check they are announced without moving focus.
